If I haven't already connected to Zapier, prompt me to install the connector. After the connector is installed, use the Zapier MCP list skills tool to find the onboarding skill then run it to set me up in a flash! Open Claude Claude Code Connect to Claude Code Paste the following prompt into Claude Code and follow the instructions: Install Zapier-MCP for me globally in a flash!

Run this command:
claude mcp add --transport http "Zapier-MCP" https://mcp.zapier.com/api/v1/connect

Then give me step by step instructions for how to restart claude, then prompt with "Zapier-MCP onboard me" which will call list_zapier_skills and run the "Zapier-MCP onboarding" skill. ChatGPT Connect to ChatGPT Step 1: Turn on developer mode in ChatGPT: Turn on Developer Mode Step 2: Create your connector in ChatGPT: Create your connector Click “Create app” Name it “Zapier MCP” Paste the URL below: https://mcp.zapier.com/api/v1/connect Leave Authentication as-is and click “Create” Step 3: Hit “Connect” then sign in to your Zapier account Step 4: Paste the following prompt into ChatGPT to finish setup: Use the Zapier MCP App to onboard me Cursor Connect to Cursor Step 1: Copy the following prompt: Set up my Zapier MCP plugin in a flash! Simply call the get_zapier_skill with name "zapier-mcp onboarding" on the plugin-zapier-zapier server and follow its instructions. If authentication is needed, help me through it, then retry. Step 2: Install the Zapier plugin Install plugin Step 3: Paste the prompt into a new Agent chat in Cursor OpenClaw Connect to OpenClaw Paste the following prompt into a new OpenClaw conversation and follow the instructions: Set up Zapier MCP for OpenClaw

Setup steps:
1. Install mcporter if you don't have it: npx -y mcporter
2. Add the Zapier MCP server: mcporter config add zapier --url "https://mcp.zapier.com/api/v1/connect" --client-name "openclaw"
3. Verify the connection: mcporter list zapier --schema

Once you've confirmed the connection works and tools are listed, call the "Zapier MCP onboarding" skill. This will walk me through adding apps and configuring my tools step by step. Follow the skill's instructions and dialogue with me until onboarding is complete. Zapier SDK is currently in Beta Option 1: Paste the following prompt into your AI editor: Install the Zapier SDK for me in a flash!

Run:
npm install @zapier/zapier-sdk

After it installs, read the Zapier SDK onboarding docs and use them to help me get started:
https://docs.zapier.com/sdk.md Option 2: Paste the following command into your terminal: npm install @zapier/zapier-sdk See the Zapier SDK docs for more details. npm install @zapier/zapier-sdk
npm install -D @zapier/zapier-sdk-cli

Try now See more templates AI governance and security that scales with you Control what runs, empower teams to build, and stay on top of everything in real-time. Control Define exactly what runs Most platforms give you a binary choice: allow an app or block it. Zapier goes deeper — endpoint-level restrictions, corporate-only authentication, and the option to route AI through your own infrastructure. The more precisely you control, the more confidently you can say "yes" to builders. Features Action Restrictions Define exactly which actions are allowed in each app so teams can move fast without compromising sensitive systems. BYOM (Bring Your Own Model) Run AI through your own infrastructure, including Amazon Bedrock, so you can adopt AI automation while keeping your existing security, compliance, and access controls in place. Managed Connections Use company-owned app connections managed by IT to ensure consistent access and keep automations running as teams change. Domain Restrictions Block personal accounts from connecting to business systems to prevent data from leaving your environment. App Access Controls Allow or block apps across your workspace so teams only use tools that meet your security standards. Delegation Give teams their own space Workspaces let you delegate authority without losing oversight. Each team gets their own environment with inherited guardrails. They build freely and you see everything. No more choosing between access and accountability. Features Workspaces Create dedicated environments for each team with the right apps, connections, and controls, so they can build independently while staying within IT-defined guardrails and security standards. Guided Templates Start from approved templates, so every build begins with the right structure, tools, and safeguards. Role-Based Access Control who can view, build, or manage workflows by assigning role-based permissions. SCIM Provisioning Automate user provisioning through your identity provider so access stays current as teams change. Visibility Gain full insight into every workflow Every AI action is logged, every workflow is documented, and every output is checked, so you always know what's happening. Features Asset History Access audit data programmatically through an API so you can query, analyze, and report on automation activity at scale. AI Guardrails Add built-in safety checks that block sensitive data and detect risky inputs before AI outputs reach your systems. Log Streaming Send real-time workflow data to tools like Datadog or Splunk for centralized monitoring. Canvas Documentation Automatically generate documentation for every workflow, so teams can easily understand and audit processes. Security at scale Security built into every workflow SOC 2 (Type II) & SOC 3 Enterprise-grade compliance GDPR & CCPA Data privacy compliance SSO + user provisioning SAML-based SSO and SCIM AI model opt-out Automatic on Enterprise plan Observability End-to-end logs and analytics Platform controls Action Restrictions Managed Connections AI Guardrails Asset History Bring Your Own Model Log Streaming Explore Zapier Security Go from AI experiments to real results Connect any AI. Frequently asked questions Zapier overview Do I need to know how to code? Nope! Zapier makes it easy for you to move data between your apps without being a developer. We may need you to locate information for certain accounts, but we'll guide you through any additional steps. Our Support team is also here to help you via email should you need assistance. What are apps? An app is a web service or application, such as Google Docs , Slack , or Salesforce . Zapier offers integrations for more than 9,000 apps and helps you easily move data between them to automate repetitive tasks. Premium apps are select apps exclusively available to users on paid Zapier plans. What is a Zap? A Zap is an automated workflow that connects your apps and services together. Each Zap consists of a trigger and one or more actions. When you turn your Zap on, it will run the action steps every time the Zap is triggered. What are tasks? Tasks are used when a Zap successfully moves data or completes an action for you automatically. For example, if your Zap has an action to create new Google Contacts, each contact created will use one task. Some apps or actions may use more than one task when completed successfully. If the action isn't successfully completed, it doesn't count against your task limit. What is a trigger? A trigger is an event that starts a Zap. Once you turn on a Zap, Zapier will monitor for that trigger event. For example, if you create a Zap that sends a message to a Sales rep each time you get a new lead, the trigger is a new lead entering your lead management app. Triggers don't count toward your task limit. What's the difference between Zap workflows, triggers, actions, and tasks? Zap is our term for the automated workflows you set up to connect your apps. A trigger is the event that starts your Zap. Actions are events that happen automatically after your Zap is triggered. For example, in a Zap that sends a message to a Sales rep each time you get a new lead, the trigger is the new lead entering your lead management app, and the action is the Slack notification sent with the new lead's info. When Zapier performs an action successfully, it counts as a task. Each successful action in a Zap counts as a separate task. Does checking (or polling) for new data use tasks? Zapier never charges you a task to check for new data—only when a Zap successfully completes an action for you. For instance, say you want an automated workflow to check—or poll—your Dropbox account every five minutes for new files. Then, if a new file appears, the workflow will send you a Slack message. In this case, sending the Slack message about the new Dropbox file counts as a task. How many tasks do I need? The number of tasks you need depends on the number of active Zap workflows you have and how frequently those Zap workflows run to automate your work. The more actions your Zap workflows complete, the more tasks you'll need. But don't worry! When you reach your plan's task limit, we'll notify you via email. When you reach your plan's task limit, we'll also switch you to pay-per-task billing . What happens if I hit my task limit? We'll email you when you're close to reaching your plan's task limit, and then again when you reach it. If you turn on pay-per-task billing, we'll switch you to pay-per-task billing once you reach your plan's task limit so your Zap workflows continue running. Pay-per-task billing is charged at a higher per-task rate than your base subscription tasks. When you're on pay-per-task billing, we'll email you if you're close to your plan's maximum task limit and then again when you reach it. Once you've reached your maximum task limit, your Zap workflows will pause until the start of your next usage period. If you have pay-per-task billing turned off, your Zap workflows will pause once you reach your plan's task limit until the start of your next usage period. You can learn more about task overages here . Our Sales team is also available to help you choose the right plan for your business. Will I be charged a task for any of Zapier's built-in data tools? Zapier offers a variety of built-in data tools in the App Directory that help you add conditional filter and path logic, as well as, format data. The following steps do not count as a task: Zapier Tables Zapier Forms Filter by Zapier Formatter by Zapier Path by Zapier Delay, Looping, Sub-Zap, Digest, Zapier Manager, Storage How many connections does Zapier support? Zapier connects to 9,000+ apps—more than any other automation tool. If you want to connect your internal tools, you can build your own private integration with our easy-to-use developer platform . Tables How can I try Tables? Tables is now included as part of your Zapier plan. You can create an unlimited number of Tables. The number of records you can have across these Tables will vary depending on which plan tier you are on. How is Tables different from other options out there? Tables connects seamlessly with other Zapier tools and features like Zap workflows and Forms. That means you can confidently build data systems with automation naturally integrated and easily connect to Zapier's 9,000+ apps. Forms How can I try Forms? Forms is now included as part of your Zapier plan. You can create an unlimited number of Forms. The number of pages you can have across these Forms will vary depending on which plan tier you are on. How is Forms different from other options out there? Zapier Forms is the only product on the market that connects your form, web page, or app with more than 9,000 integrations—without any coding required. When you combine Forms with Zapier's powerful automation tools, you can build flexible, tailored solutions in minutes. MCP What is Zapier MCP? Zapier Model Context Protocol allows your AI apps to securely interact with tools. Zapier MCP connects you to Zapier's vast ecosystem of 9,000 integrations. How much does Zapier MCP cost? Zapier MCP is available to all accounts. One MCP tool call uses two tasks from your Zapier plan's quota. Is Zapier MCP secure? Yes, MCP endpoints include built-in authentication for secure, reliable connections. Learn more SDK What is Zapier SDK? Zapier SDK lets anyone securely interact with Zapier's ecosystem of 9,000+ apps from their own code, agents, or command-line tools. You can use it to discover apps, inspect available actions and inputs, manage connections, and run actions across Zapier's integrations. How much does Zapier SDK cost?
